title: Nucleus Lockfile
description: Pinned versions for all package managers used across nucleus hosts.

updated.description: Last update timestamp in ISO-8601 format.

scoop.description: Scoop package versions. Package name → version string.

cargo-binstall.description: cargo-binstall crate versions. Crate name → version string.

bun.description: Bun-installed global package versions. Package name → version string.

uv.description: uv (pip) tool versions. Tool name → version string.

rustup.description: Rustup toolchain versions. Channel name → date string.

winget.description: WinGet package identifiers and versions. Package ID → version string.

vscode.description: VS Code extension versions. Extension ID → version string.

pwsh.description: PowerShell module versions. Module name → version string.

ollama.description: Ollama model pins per host. Host name → array of model specs.
